statuses.name: Blind
statuses.effect: Each attack of the unit has a 50% chance to miss. A miss moves Momentum 1 against the unit's side.

statuses.name: Poisoned
statuses.effect: 1 damage per 5 time units, built up and landing whenever any unit gets a turn.

statuses.name: Bleeding
statuses.effect: 2 damage after each `melee` or `move` skill the unit uses (Move included).

statuses.name: Silenced
statuses.effect: The unit cannot use `magical` skills or a magical attack.

statuses.name: Frozen
statuses.effect: The unit's next turn is skipped, at the skipped-turn cost (section 6.1). It cannot intercept. It ends early when fire is set on the unit's spot.

statuses.name: Stunned
statuses.effect: The unit takes no actions and cannot intercept. Each of its turns that arrives while Stunned is skipped, at the skipped-turn cost. Any hit ends it early.

statuses.name: Confused
statuses.effect: Each skill the unit uses, helpful ones included, has a 50% chance to target a random legal unit instead, on either side.

statuses.name: Immobilized
statuses.effect: The unit cannot Move and cannot be moved. It cannot intercept.

statuses.name: Marked
statuses.effect: Only enemies can be Marked. A skill that reads a Mark works on every Marked enemy, whoever placed it. A Mark lasts 30 time units unless the marking skill says otherwise (Relentless); the marking skill states any limit.
